transcript.text: Hi everyone. Before we finalize the rollout plan for the new search-ranking model next week, I need to hear from each required team. Search Platform, SRE, Customer Success, and Compliance — please report any relevant constraints or required follow-up commitments you have for this rollout. The current draft enables the model for 25% of all tenants on Monday at 09:00 UTC, keeps ranking-event logs for 30 days, applies standard automated ranking behavior to every tenant, and has no special customer-notification step. Let's hear your concerns or sign-offs.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a constraint from Search Platform. Yesterday during compatibility testing for a separate ticket, I confirmed that the new ranking model is incompatible with the custom tokenization used by exactly three tenants: Lattice Health, Northwind Legal, and Solace Retail. These tenants must be excluded from the first rollout cohort. I haven't updated the rollout ticket yet because the test finished after the ticket's last review.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a scheduling constraint from SRE. I confirmed 20 minutes ago that a database maintenance operation will occupy the search index cluster on Monday morning, so the model rollout cannot start at Monday 09:00 UTC as currently drafted. The rollout must start at exactly Tuesday 02:00 UTC and use the one-hour 02:00–03:00 UTC deployment window. I hadn't posted the collision yet because the maintenance owner is still updating the operations calendar, but given we're finalizing the plan now, this needs to be reflected.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a constraint from Customer Success. During a customer contract review this morning, I found that Lattice Health and Northwind Legal require five business days' advance notice before any algorithmic ranking change affecting their accounts. Neither customer has been notified yet, and I hadn't added this to the engineering rollout ticket because the review was part of a separate renewal task.

transcript.text: I need to flag a compliance constraint. During this quarter's audit preparation, I confirmed that ranking decisions for regulated tenants must have audit logs retained for exactly 180 days and must offer a human-review path. The current draft's 30-day retention and fully automated behavior do not satisfy that policy. I haven't opened the compliance task yet because the audit evidence request arrived only this afternoon, but this must be addressed before the rollout is finalized.

commitments.detail: Update the rollout ticket to reflect the exclusion of Lattice Health, Northwind Legal, and Solace Retail from the first rollout cohort due to custom tokenization incompatibility.
Update the operations calendar and rollout ticket to reflect the Tuesday 02:00–03:00 UTC deployment window, replacing the original Monday 09:00 UTC start.

Provide five business days' advance notice to Lattice Health and Northwind Legal before any future rollout that includes them, per their contract requirements. They are excluded from this initial rollout.
Open the compliance task and confirm that ranking-event logs for regulated tenants are retained for 180 days and that a human-review path is enabled before the rollout proceeds.

Ensure the final rollout plan reflects: 25% of tenants excluding the three incompatible tenants, Tuesday 02:00 UTC start, 180-day log retention, human-review path enabled, and no special customer notification for this initial cohort (since all tenants requiring notice are excluded).
